brief_rationale: No serious or minor responsibility-chain errors were identified. All six RC items were met with specific doctor actions and family confirmation. One high-order point (HO3 dynamic reprioritization) was actively completed with meaningful trajectory impact, establishing correct sequencing between psychiatric safety, medication verification, and cardiology follow-up. Other high-order points were partially addressed but did not meet completion criteria. The trajectory achieved Strong grade: no in-chain errors, dimensions at good or above, safe and executable closure, and one completed high-order point.
